import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("ZIP CONTENTS:")
    for n in names:
        print(' ', n)
    shared = None
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        shared = []
        for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
            txt = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(txt)
        print("\nSHARED STRINGS (%d):" % len(shared))
        for i, s in enumerate(shared):
            print(' ', i, repr(s))
    print("\nWORKBOOK RELS:")
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    for rel in root:
        print(' ', rel.attrib)
    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print("\nSHEETS:")
    for s in wbroot.findall('.//m:sheet', NS):
        print(' ', s.attrib)

import zipfile, shutil
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

src = 'sales_data.xlsx'
tmp = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

# ---- modify sheet1.xml ----
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as z:
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
    styles_xml = z.read('xl/styles.xml')

sroot = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension').set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
col = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
col.set('width', '15'); col.set('customWidth', '1'); col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8')

def make_cell(ref, style, formula=None, text=None):
    c = ET.Element(f'{{{NS}}}c')
    c.set('r', ref)
    if style is not None:
        c.set('s', str(style))
    if text is not None:
        c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_ = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
        t = ET.SubElement(is_, f'{{{NS}}}t')
        t.text = text
    if formula is not None:
        f = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
        f.text = formula
    return c

sheet_data = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
for row in sheet_data.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if r == 1:
        row.append(make_cell('H1', 1, text='Profit Margin %'))
    elif 2 <= r <= 9:
        row.append(make_cell(f'H{r}', 3, formula=f'G{r}/E{r}'))
    elif r == 10:
        row.append(make_cell('H10', 3, formula='G10/E10'))

new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(sroot, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

# ---- modify styles.xml: add 0.0% number format + new xf ----
stroot = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
numfmts = stroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numfmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
nf.set('numFmtId', '164'); nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
cellxfs = stroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
cellxfs.set('count', '4')
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('fontId', '0'); xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0'); xf.set('pivotButton', '0'); xf.set('quotePrefix', '0'); xf.set('xfId', '0')
new_styles_xml = ET.tostring(stroot, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

# ---- rewrite zip ----
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = new_sheet_xml
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = new_styles_xml
        zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(tmp, src)
print('done')
